author: Cytokinesis
body:
This is the map i made with DaBaderMC.
The teams are purple vs red
There are 3 monuments per team
There are hidden chest at the top of the towers with an enchanted sword and an enchanted bow
Each player spawns with:
-full dyed leather armour
-stone sword
-bow(infinity)
-diamond pickaxe
-2 golden apples
-32 oak logs
-64 glass blocks
-16 steak
-4 experience potions
-nether star(shop)
-32 arrows
[Update] The Magic Blade and Magic Bow have been replaced with the Flame sword(FireAspect1) and the Fire Bow(Flame1) enchantment tables have been added.diamonds have been added to the center as well as a chest with a sword and bows with weak enchantments
Image Album: http://imgur.com/a/Vrunu#0
Download:coming soon
YAML: http://pastebin.com/waCDr7Hp

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Monuments. The monuments are really plain and don't have much structure to them. As well as, the would be rather hard to get to. They are all behind the spawn structure and have too much void space in between. Perhaps moving the monument island out from behind the spawn and reducing void space.

Side note: The map is okay, but it is just below good. Map Developers need to be a bit more stricter and with small improvements based on the points I made, this map may then, get accepted.
